title: Create Reatomized: Pillager Caravans
description: A datapack for Obscuria's Pillager Caravans which replaces their Vanilla style caravans with a total of 90 new caravans which include many modded mobs.
body: A Datapack which adds caravans for Obscuria's Pillager Caravans mod. These Caravans include mobs from _Scorched Guns 2_, _Savage & Ravage_, _Raids:Enhanced_, _It Takes a Pillage_, and _Born in Chaos_. There are a total of 90 caravans that spawn across differing climates. Specifically made for compatibility with Biomes O' Plenty, Regions Unexplored, and Terralith. **Disable the default Pillager Caravans' "Classic Caravans" datapack before use.**
